verdict.rationale: LibreChat's documented Agents feature lets users build several custom agents in the Agent Builder, each backed by its chosen model provider, and pick one per conversation from the Side Panel dropdown or by @-mention in chat. That covers creating distinct agents and routing conversations to them. It does not show isolated per-agent workspaces or routing of external channels. missing for 10: explicit per-agent system-prompt documentation, per-agent isolated workspaces, channel-level routing (e.g. messaging channels bound to specific agents), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can run multiple distinct agents with their own prompts, models, and workspaces, and route conversations or channels to each

citations.quote: LibreChat's AI Agents feature provides a flexible framework for creating custom AI assistants powered by various model providers.
To create a new agent, select "Agents" from the endpoint menu and open the Agent Builder panel found in the Side Panel.
Existing agents can be selected from the top dropdown of the Side Panel. Also by mention with "@" in the chat input.
